prompt: Write C64 BASIC to read the joystick in control port 2 and print which direction is being pushed (and whether fire is pressed). Which memory location and bits do I read?
assertions: Reads control port 2 at 56320 ($DC00, CIA1 port A)
Treats the direction bits 0-3 as up/down/left/right
Treats bit 4 as the fire button
Notes the bits are active-LOW (0 = pressed)
